note: Names, descriptions and grades follow the official PlayStation list as reported by the trackers. Every guide paragraph below is written for this atlas in its own words, with its sources named beside it.

trophies.guide: This is the reward for everything else: it unlocks the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so there is no separate task to chase. One playthrough is enough, nothing online is needed, and no downloadable content is required. Work through the story first, then the side strands, then the open-world cleanup, and this one will pop on its own at the end.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
The platinum unlocks automatically once the last one lands.

trophies.guide: Play through the opening of Chapter 1 and finish the mission Gone Fishing, the second mission of the story after the prologue. It is an automatic story trophy, so just keep following the mission markers and it cannot be missed. The name is also the title of Chapter 1 itself.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Start Chapter 1.
Finish the mission Gone Fishing.

trophies.guide: Finish every main mission of Chapter 1. The trophy does not pop at the final cutscene of the chapter; it lands once you complete the first main mission of Chapter 2, called What's in the Bag? Do not be confused by the name: Paradise Lost is also the title of Chapter 2, but this trophy is for completing Chapter 1.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Complete all Chapter 1 main missions.
Start Chapter 2 and finish What's in the Bag? — the trophy pops then.

trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 2 to its end. Like the other chapter trophies, this one pops a little late: it arrives when Chapter 3 begins, after you finish its first main mission, Welcome to Vice City. The name shown on PlayStation is censored with asterisks; the uncensored chapter title is the title of Chapter 3.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Complete all Chapter 2 main missions.
Begin Chapter 3 and finish Welcome to Vice City.

trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3 in full. The pop is delayed again: it comes after you complete the first two main missions of Chapter 4, Ocean Beach and Another Life. Vice City, Baby is also the title of Chapter 4, so the trophy name tells you where the story is heading next rather than where it has been.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Complete all Chapter 3 main missions.
Start Chapter 4 and finish Ocean Beach and Another Life.

trophies.guide: Play Chapter 4 through to its last main mission, Starting From Zero, and this trophy pops right after it. Top of the World, Ma is also the title of the final chapter, Chapter 5, which has only seven missions. From here the story is on its last stretch.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Complete all Chapter 4 main missions.
Finish Starting From Zero, the final mission of Chapter 4.

trophies.guide: Finish the last mission of the story in Chapter 5. It is a gold trophy and an automatic story unlock, so there is nothing extra to prepare and no way to miss it. Free-roam continues after the credits, so everything else on the list can still be done afterwards. The name of the final mission itself is not confirmed by two independent sources, so this atlas does not state it.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Play through Chapter 5.
Finish the final mission and watch the credits roll.

trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a main mission in Chapter 2, the eighth of its eleven missions. Just play the story in order and the trophy unlocks when the mission ends. There is no choice or optional objective attached to it.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Reach Chapter 2.
Finish the mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is the last mission of Chapter 3, a big heist job that closes the chapter. Finish it and the trophy is yours. Because it sits at the very end of the chapter, earning it also means you are one step from the Chapter 3 completion trophy.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Play through Chapter 3.
Finish The Cartel Heist, the final mission of the chapter.

trophies.guide: Child's Play is a main mission in Chapter 4. Complete it as part of the story and the trophy unlocks automatically. Its exact position inside Chapter 4's mission list has not been verified, so this atlas does not claim a mission number for it.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Reach Chapter 4.
Finish the mission Child's Play.

trophies.guide: Headliners is a main mission in Chapter 4. Finish it during the story and the trophy pops on its own. Like the other mission trophies, there is no special condition to meet and nothing to prepare in advance.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Reach Chapter 4.
Finish the mission Headliners.

trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is a main mission in Chapter 4, set around Vice City International Airport. Complete it and the trophy unlocks. The airport also matters later for a separate open-world trophy, but that one is unrelated to this mission.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Reach Chapter 4.
Finish the mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is a main mission in Chapter 5, reported as the fifth of its seven missions, about recovering a shipment. Finish it and the trophy pops. With only two missions left in the chapter after it, the finale is close at this point.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Reach Chapter 5.
Finish the mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.guide: This gold trophy is the long grind behind the platinum: reach 100% completion on the in-game checklist. The checklist has 35 requirements in three groups — story and tasks, exploration and activities, and discovery — and it only becomes viewable after the story, at Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion, although progress made during the story already counts. Most items only need a share of the total, for example 15 of 18 card sets or 300 of 397 stunts; only a few demand the full count, such as all 42 shooting-range gold medals, all 42 drone time trials, all 33 underwater discoveries, all 15 of Bret's target decks, and every robbery. Nothing on the checklist is missable, and it is all doable in free-roam after the credits. Expect roughly 100 hours of cleanup after a 60 to 80 hour story.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story to unlock the checklist view at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.
Clear the 35 checklist requirements, starting with the full-count ones.
Mop up the partial-count items last, since many finish on their own.

trophies.guide: Complete any 250 stunts out of 397 in the world. The four kinds are stunt jumps off ramps, flying under bridges, knife flights between buildings, and base jumps with a parachute, and you can mix them freely. Flying under bridges is reported as the quickest way to build the count. Each stunt icon may show an optional challenge, but that challenge is not required — performing the stunt once is enough for it to count. The 100% checklist wants 300, so keep going past this trophy if you are chasing the gold.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Open the map filter for stunt spots and pick a dense area.
Perform 250 stunts in any mix of the four kinds.
Track progress at Progress > Activities > Stunts.

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each of the nine activity types at least once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race, and performing a stunt. Most of these happen naturally while you work on other trophies and the 100% checklist, so this one usually pops without a dedicated session. You can check each type's progress under Progress, then Activities. Whether the in-game golf activity is full golf or mini golf has not been verified, so this atlas does not assert either.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Try fishing, hunting, golf, a shooting range, pool and basketball once each.
Play a video game, win a race, and perform one stunt.
Check Progress > Activities to see which types are still missing.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 shooting-range challenges. There are only two ranges and twelve challenges between them: Griffin Shooting Range in northwestern Vice City has six challenges with three gold difficulties each, and Rodgers Ranch northeast of Port Gellhorn has six challenges with four gold difficulties each. At each range, buy a Waiver Pass for 5 dollars from the clerk first; if you do not own the required weapon, renting it costs 10 dollars per challenge. Some challenges are timed courses and others are score targets. This is also a full-count item on the 100% checklist, so it has to be done completely either way.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit Griffin Shooting Range, buy the 5 dollar Waiver Pass, and gold all six challenges.
Do the same at Rodgers Ranch for its six challenges.
Track progress at Progress > Activities > Shooting Ranges.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 locations; one win per location is enough. There are 42 drone time trials in total, three per location, and the 100% checklist needs all of them. The trials unlock in order: beat the par time in the first two races to open the third, which only needs to be finished. Drone races are time trials through a course, so keep full throttle and steer around obstacles. The full list of all 14 location names has not been verified, so this atlas does not print one.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find a Top Fun drone location on the map and win its first race.
Repeat at all 14 locations.
For the 100% checklist, beat par in the first two trials per location, then finish the third.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Winning the same race twice does not add to the count, so keep moving to fresh ones; there are 40 unique races to choose from, and the 100% checklist wants 30 of them won. Race challenges with gold medals are a separate thing and are not needed for this trophy. Blue race icons appear on the map when you get close to them.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Pick a race you have not won yet and win it.
Repeat with 19 more different races.
Keep going to 30 different wins if you are chasing 100%.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal Hampton in a fishing challenge. The questline starts after the Chapter 1 main mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal; after that he sends a text that marks a fishing spot with a purple icon on the map. Follow his fishing questline through to the challenge itself and beat him at it. Fishing is one of the nine activity types, so this also ticks a box for the activities trophy.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Finish the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui to meet Cal.
Wait for Cal's text and follow the purple fishing marker.
Complete his questline and beat him in the fishing challenge.

trophies.guide: Finish any one of the four arcade games. Three of them — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind — are played on the television at home by interacting with the controllers, and they are available from Chapter 1. The fourth, Bang For Your Buck, is found on arcade cabinets around Leonida. Completing a game means finishing all of its levels at least once; you do not need to beat every challenge inside it. Pick whichever game suits you best. The 100% checklist wants all four games started, which is a lower bar than finishing one.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Go home and use the TV controllers, or find an arcade cabinet.
Pick one of the four games and play it through to the end.
For the 100% checklist, start each of the other three as well.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission of Andy's questline, a Lucia-only strand that opens in Chapter 3 when Lucia gets a call from Andy, followed by a text with her home address in Belville. There are five quests in order, from the Cellerichain initiation through paying the fee and retrieving the van, ending at the warehouse meet. The whole strand stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 and answer Andy's call.
Work through the five quests in order.
Finish the final quest, the warehouse meet, to unlock the trophy.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's questline, which is about recovering treasure from seven shipwrecks. It opens in Chapter 1, a while after the main mission Island Dreams where you work for Kenton; he calls, and his shop is marked with a green KR icon in Key Lento. Dive at the purple treasure-chest markers, use the metal detector to dig treasure from the ocean floor, and bring it back to him. He disappears after Chapter 1 and texts again later, in Chapters 2 to 3, so do not worry if he goes quiet — the quests are still available after the story.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Finish Island Dreams in Chapter 1, then answer Kenton's call.
Dive the seven shipwreck sites and return each treasure to Kenton.
Track progress at Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish the last mission of Billy's questline at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. It unlocks automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break. There are five quests in order, from checking out the mud club through a couple of jobs with Billy, stealing the Impaler, and the final job together. The strand stays open after the story.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Finish Coffee Break in Chapter 2 to unlock the strand.
Work through Billy's five quests at the Thrillbilly Mudclub.
Finish the final quest, Hometown Heroes.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight full mission strands for strangers around Leonida. Four strands are confirmed as counting: Kirk and his Skunk Ape search, Kyle at McKittrick Farm, Yago and his street racing, and Pilot Pete with his delivery flights. Other familiar questlines — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie — do not count toward this trophy, so do not rely on them for the number. The remaining four qualifying strands have not been confirmed by any source this atlas could check, so use the trophy counter in the trophy list to test each strand you finish. One warning inside Yago's strand: his Race Against Yago is time-sensitive and shows an hourglass icon, so do it as soon as it appears, in Chapter 3. Every strand stays available in free-roam after the story.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Finish the Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete strands.
Do Yago's time-sensitive race the moment it appears.
Check the trophy counter after each new strand to find the other four.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Deliver sixteen sports cars on Randy's wish list to his garage in west Vice City, marked with a green RK icon. The strand opens automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, where you steal the Zorrusso for Randy and unlock the Key Cloner; that first car is delivered as part of the story. Randy marks some cars in fixed spots, and you can also steal them off the street; scanning a high-end sports car with the WAiNK app tells you whether it is on the list. Delivering a car in good condition pays more. The best hunting ground is reported to be east Vice City around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. All sixteen are still deliverable after the story.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Finish Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS in Chapter 3.
Scan sports cars with WAiNK to spot wish-list cars.
Deliver all sixteen cars to Randy's garage in good condition.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's questline, a Jason-only strand that opens automatically after the Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty. The work is shutting down synthetic drug labs: go to the labs marked in purple around Vice City and destroy them, then complete the final mission, Spin On This, which shuts the labs down for good. The strand stays available after the story.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Play as Jason after Here, Kitty Kitty in Chapter 3.
Destroy the synthetic labs at the purple markers.
Finish the final mission, Spin On This.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all eighteen spots across ten locations. Meditating at a spot with both Jason and Lucia counts double, so bring your partner every time. The final meditation cannot be done until both characters can play together, after Chapter 2's Coffee Break. The 100% checklist only needs fifteen of the eighteen, but this trophy needs all of them. Track your progress at Progress, then Collections, then Exploration, then Meditations. WARNING — the one missable moment in the whole game: in Chapter 1, in the morning after the main mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house. She says she will meditate and walks to the balcony; follow her, look at her and choose Accept. That moment is gone after Chapter 1 and there is no mission replay, so do it and keep a manual save from Chapter 1. Honest note: it is not yet confirmed whether that balcony meditation is strictly required for the trophy, because it raises the counter by one but is not marked as a meditation spot like the others — do it anyway, just in case.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: Chapter 1, morning after Down to Earth: meditate with Lucia on the balcony — do not skip this.
After Coffee Break in Chapter 2, meditate at each spot with both characters.
Check Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations until all 18 are done.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel of Killtelligence Provisions. This is a Jason-only questline that opens automatically after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when Jason gets a text from Bret marking the first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County. After that, Bret marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he asks for and bring them back to him as Jason. The first quest gives you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69. A clean shot to the head or heart leaves the animal in Pristine condition and pays more, and Bret only accepts animals in Pristine or Good condition. There are fifteen target decks in total and the 100% checklist needs all of them. Which exact animal triggers this trophy has not been confirmed by the guides yet, so this atlas does not name one.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Play as Jason after Coffee Break and answer Bret's text.
Meet Bret for Veteran Hunted and take the Killtelligence SM-69.
Work through Bret's hunting requests and return the animals to him.

trophies.guide: Complete any three of the eighteen collectible card sets. There are 480 unique cards in total, found all over the world — inside buildings on surfaces or stuck to walls, and outside in yellow phone boxes or tool boxes. The same card can appear in different colour versions, and each colour counts as its own card for set completion, while duplicates found at several locations do not count twice. Cards can be sold at any pawn shop for 20 to over 1,000 dollars depending on rarity, and selling them does not remove them from your collections list. The fastest route is the smallest sets: Backyard Wrestling has 12 cards and Delights Dancers has 18. The 100% checklist wants fifteen of the eighteen sets. Only 58 of the 480 cards have documented locations so far, so this atlas does not pretend to map them all.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Pick the smallest sets first: Backyard Wrestling (12) and Delights Dancers (18).
Search phone boxes, tool boxes and building interiors for cards.
Track sets at Progress > Collections > Collectible Cards.

trophies.guide: Scan one hundred WAiNK locations with the phone app. WAiNK unlocks in Chapter 1, in mission six, Unwanted Attention. On foot, hold Up on the D-pad to open WAiNK directly, point the phone at the object and hold R1 to scan; a popup appears when a scannable location is nearby. Any mix counts toward the hundred: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher Tags markings on the ground, which make up the rest — their total count has not been verified. The same bar is needed for the 100% checklist. Do not mix this up with WAiNK vehicle scans, which count toward different trophies.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Unlock WAiNK in Chapter 1, mission Unwanted Attention.
On foot, hold Up to open WAiNK and hold R1 to scan sights.
Track progress at Progress > Collections > WAiNK Locations.

trophies.guide: Complete any fifty challenges out of eighty. The challenges sit in eight categories of ten each — combat, criminal, exploration, fitness, shopping, sports, survival and vehicle — and you can view them at Progress, then Challenges, where finished ones show a tick. Many complete naturally while you play, so leave this one for late in the run and then pick the easiest remaining ones. The 100% checklist wants seventy of the eighty, so this trophy pops on the way there. Each finished category is reported to unlock cheats, but remember that cheats disable trophies and saving, so do not use them on a trophy run.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Play normally and let challenges tick off on their own.
Late in the run, open Progress > Challenges and pick the easiest unfinished ones.
Reach 50 completed challenges; keep going to 70 for the 100% checklist.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build up a four-star wanted level and then escape the red heat zone — the trophy pops only once you leave that zone, not just the flashing search area. Partners are available from the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break onwards, when you can switch characters and call your partner. A good escape route is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where police and helicopters struggle to follow on the tracks. It also pops naturally during bank-vault robberies, which always give four stars.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Call your partner to join you after Coffee Break.
Cause enough trouble to reach a four-star wanted level.
Escape the red heat zone completely, for example through the Ambrosia train tunnel.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, rob three shops in a row while staying wanted the whole time. If your stars fade down to only the red heat zone, the chain breaks, so keep the wanted level alive between shops. The trophy pop is delayed by about thirty seconds after you leave the third shop; if it does not appear, rob a fourth shop. A good spot is the three jewelry stores in north Vice City, available after the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs. Stock up on body armor, sticky bombs and healing supplies from Ammu-Nation first.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Bring your partner and stock up at Ammu-Nation.
Rob three shops in a row without letting the wanted level die.
Wait about thirty seconds after the third shop; rob a fourth if it does not pop.

trophies.guide: Discover one hundred vehicles. Open the WAiNK app on the phone by holding Up on the D-pad, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it — scanning counts as discovering, and you do not need to drive it. There are 557 vehicles at launch, from cars and bikes to boats, helicopters and planes. A fast method is to stand by a busy road and scan passing traffic. Progress is shown at Progress, then Vehicles. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so this pops naturally on the way there.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Hold Up to open WAiNK and hold R1 to scan vehicles.
Scan passing traffic from a busy roadside.
Track progress at Progress > Vehicles.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down five enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Combat Focus is triggered with L3 and R3 while aiming a firearm: it slows time, highlights weak spots and drains the purple Focus bar. Focus only lasts a few seconds, so prepare first — eat or drink, or use Adrenaline to stretch the time, and raise your Focus level through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, since level four makes it much easier. Gang enemies at illegal operations are the best targets; the guides report that soldiers, police and civilians do not count. A full-auto assault rifle and body armor from Ammu-Nation help.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Raise Focus toward level four and carry Adrenaline.
Find a group of gang enemies at an illegal operation.
Trigger Combat Focus with L3 + R3 and drop five of them in one use.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal boarding bridge at Vice City International Airport — planes parked out on the airfield do not count. The easiest gates are E3 and E4: drive through the airfield fence, take the stairs and door next to the boarding bridge, go upstairs into the cockpit, drive the plane backwards to the runway and take off. The trophy pops after you fly about one kilometre away from the airport. Expect a four-star wanted level and a fast police response, so save first.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Save first, then head to VCIA gates E3 or E4.
Board a large plane at a departure boarding bridge.
Take off and fly about one kilometre away from the airport.

trophies.guide: Steal a military tank, a Rhino, at Mile Zero Air Station — the island at the far southwestern edge of the map, in Mariana County. The tanks are parked at the south end of the base. Enter through the gate, or use a stunt jump next to the south-east entrance, then climb into a tank, drive it and shoot enemies until the trophy pops.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Travel to Mile Zero Air Station on the far southwestern island.
Enter the base and find the tanks at its south end.
Drive a Rhino and fire at enemies until the trophy pops.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being seen. First you need the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs, which unlocks jewelry store robberies and the Snap Gun, a silent lockpick for alarmed doors that stays in your inventory permanently. Use the Snap Gun on the locked back door — kicking the door sets off the alarm and fails the stealth condition. Inside the back room, find the note with the safe code, open the safe with it, and leave unseen. If you are spotted, reload your save. A good target is Richardson Jewelry and Diamonds in Vice City.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3 to get the Snap Gun.
Pick the locked back door with the Snap Gun, never by kicking it.
Find the safe code note, open the safe, and leave unseen.

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape; the 100% checklist needs all eight. Vaults unlock with the optional Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is, waiting at the cafe — the first vault is done as part of that mission. The method is to tail an armored security van to a large bank: a guard carries cash inside and the vault opens briefly, so go in quickly while it is open. You cannot carry all the bags alone, so bring your partner and hand one bag over. Every vault robbery gives an instant four-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and then switch vehicles or use a Pay 'n' Spray. After the intro mission, Yasmani the fence sells security-van tips for 10,000 dollars once you have robbed two payday loans; the tips mark vans with a purple icon. A single vault can pay up to about 205,000 dollars.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Finish the Chapter 4 mission That's Where The Money Is to unlock vaults.
Tail a security van to a large bank and slip in while the vault is open.
Bring your partner for the bags, then escape the four-star heat.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. The easiest way is through the bank vaults: robbing a vault counts as robbing an armored truck, and the same Chapter 4 mission unlocks it, so this trophy usually pops while you work on the vaults. The earlier method is to find an armored truck driving around Vice City near banks, block its path, plant a sticky bomb on the back door, blow it open, and escape the red heat zone or reach a Pay 'n' Spray. Sticky bombs are available in the back of Yasmani's shop after his quests. The trophy only pops once you have escaped the red heat radius.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Unlock vaults in Chapter 4, or find an armored truck near a bank.
Rob the truck or the vault it leads to.
Escape the red heat zone to trigger the pop.

trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida by fully unfogging the whole map. The fastest method is to fly a plane over every fogged area until the entire map is visible. Leonida is split into six named regions and five counties, from Vice City and the Keys in the south to Mount Kalaga National Park in the north, and the map is roughly twice the size of the previous game's. There is no extra requirement beyond clearing the fog, according to the guides.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Get a plane and fly over every blacked-out part of the map.
Keep going until no fog remains anywhere.
Check the map: the whole state should be visible.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the nine gangs. There are 39 illegal gang operations in total, and the 100% checklist needs all of them, so this trophy is the first ninth of that job. Operations show as yellow icons on the map when you are nearby, and many are marked automatically as the story progresses. Track your progress at Progress, then Gangs, by scrolling over each gang — the corner of the screen shows how many of its operations you have robbed. Honest gap: no launch-day guide lists the full in-game roster of nine gang names, so this atlas does not invent them — read the names from the in-game Progress, then Gangs screen.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Follow yellow operation icons on the map.
Rob one operation for each gang.
Check Progress > Gangs to see which gangs are still missing.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: This trophy's exact trigger is not confirmed yet. The description itself points to ordering or drinking a cocktail at a spot with a view on Ocean Beach in Vice City, but as of launch day no guide could confirm the venue, the interaction prompt, or any time or character requirement. This atlas will not invent steps for it: try the bars and viewpoints along Ocean Beach in free-roam, and re-check the cited guides, which are updating as players confirm it. Whether it can be missed is likewise unconfirmed, though nothing suggests a one-time window.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Head to Ocean Beach in Vice City.
Try the bars and viewpoints along the beach for a cocktail interaction.
Re-check the cited guides for a confirmed trigger.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: This trophy's exact trigger is not confirmed yet. The description points to driving a car out through the window of a vehicle showroom, in the style of a classic scene, but which showroom counts and whether it must be done in a specific way are all unconfirmed. This atlas will not invent steps for it: try driving a car through a showroom window in free-roam and re-check the cited guides as players confirm the details.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Find a vehicle showroom with a big front window.
Drive a car through the window to exit the showroom.
Re-check the cited guides for a confirmed trigger.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Rob Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, the gang operation at the Kolt and Associates bowling alley. It is first marked by the optional Chapter 2 mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. You must steal all three key valuables: a luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on a table in the north-east corner, and the contents of the office safe in the north-east hallway, which you blow open with sticky bombs bought at Ammu-Nation first. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and killing enemies is not necessary. If you miss an item, the operation respawns after a long time and you can return for just the remaining valuables. One secondary source instead says to bowl a game at the alley; the three main guides agree it is the robbery, so this atlas follows them.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Take the optional Chapter 2 mission Hit Kingpin Bowling.
Steal the watch, the Gutterball shotgun and the safe contents.
Escape the police — the trophy pops then.

trophies.guide: Reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time. This is only possible after the Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break, when character switching opens up. Check each character's Strength under the Jason and Lucia screen. Buy a gym or fitness-club membership and always train together with your partner — while one trains, the other completes training too, so progress counts double. Fitness clubs can be filtered on the map under Activities, and after the story you can also work out at home.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Unlock character switching in Chapter 2, Coffee Break.
Buy a gym membership and train with your partner every time.
Keep both characters' Strength at maximum together.

trophies.guide: Perform five hundred actions that affect your Criminal Profile. First turn the tracking on: in Settings, then UI, then HUD Notifications, set Criminal Profile to On, and a demon-face icon appears on the right side of the screen whenever an action affects your reputation. The profile has tiers — Professional for stealthy robberies and clean escapes, Hardened for non-lethal takedowns, Violent for killing, Psycho for killing many police and civilians, and Irredeemable, which is permanent and makes police shoot on sight more, so avoid pushing that far. The count fills passively from robberies and enemy encounters while you work on other trophies, and the trophy list itself shows the counter. If you are short at the end, the guides suggest farming by running over civilians and police with a car, while warning not to reach Irredeemable.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Turn Criminal Profile notifications on in Settings > UI > HUD Notifications.
Play normally — robberies and fights fill the counter.
Watch the trophy counter and top it up late in the run, without reaching Irredeemable.

trophies.guide: This trophy's exact trigger is not confirmed yet. The description suggests succeeding at something on a second attempt. The only lead is a belief, not a confirmation, that it relates to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. This atlas will not present that lead as fact, and it flags the open question openly: if the trigger really is tied to a one-time prologue event, it could matter early, so it is worth re-checking the cited guides before you finish the prologue. Do not take any step here as verified.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Re-check the cited guides for a confirmed trigger.
Do not assume any single step until two sources agree.
If it is tied to the prologue, handle it before the prologue ends.

trophies.guide: This trophy's exact trigger is not confirmed yet. The guides believe it comes from a UFO questline, but that is a belief, not a confirmation. The single lead so far is a video report of a UFO random encounter in Kelly County after 2am: a car with flickering lights waits at the roadside, a UFO appears further up the road, you talk to the stranger, then go back to her car. That report has no second source behind it as of launch day, so this atlas treats it as a lead, not a verified method. Try it in free-roam late at night in Kelly County and re-check the cited guides.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: After 2am, look for a roadside car with flickering lights in Kelly County.
Follow the encounter up the road and talk to the stranger.
Re-check the cited guides for a second confirmation.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: This trophy's exact trigger is not confirmed yet. The description points to knocking people down with a melee attack from a vehicle — a melee drive-by — and the working guess is kicking enemies while riding a motorcycle. How many targets are needed is unknown; the name suggests ten, but that is only an inference from the name and this atlas does not state it as a count. Try melee attacks from a moving vehicle in free-roam and re-check the cited guides for a confirmed method.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Ride a motorcycle and try kicking enemies from the bike.
Also try melee attacks from other moving vehicles.
Re-check the cited guides for a confirmed trigger and count.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn 250,000 dollars by laundering marked bills through your contacts. First you need the Dye Pack Jammer, unlocked by the Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check, where you meet Raul's crew. Marked bills come from robbing banks and payday loans — there are seven payday loan locations — and you launder them by delivering them to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City is reported to pay the most. The 250,000 dollars is a cumulative total, not a single delivery, and it builds naturally while you do robberies for the 100% checklist. A single large bank vault can hold up to about 205,000 dollars, though vaults only unlock in Chapter 4.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Finish Credit Check in Chapter 3 to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Rob banks and payday loans for marked bills.
Deliver the bills to a fence, ideally Yasmani, until 250,000 dollars is laundered.

trophies.guide: Spend 100,000 dollars across all shops, counted cumulatively — not in one shop and not in one purchase. The fastest way is the most expensive items: guns, car mods and tattoos, though every shop type counts. Leonida has dozens of each kind, from 67 clothing stores and 24 Ammu-Nations down to 11 tattoo studios. This total builds on its own while you buy weapons, clothes and vehicle upgrades for other trophies.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Buy guns, car mods and tattoos — the priciest items.
Spend across any shops; the total is cumulative.
Keep an eye on the trophy counter as you shop.

trophies.guide: Buy all eight purchasable garages, for 160,000 dollars in total. Buy them through the Vice City Real Estate phone app, unlocked after the Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver, where you steal the Crawler for Moses, or in person at the properties. The four garages given by the story do not count, and neither does the Ultimate Edition bonus garage — only the eight you buy. The cheapest is Mitchell Auto Center at 4,000 dollars and the priciest is Atlantic Court Garage at 40,000. Buying garages also matters for registering cars, since each registration needs a free garage space.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Unlock the Vice City Real Estate app after Daily Driver in Chapter 2.
Buy the eight garages, cheapest first.
Story-given garages do not count — only the eight purchases.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. The app is installed on your phone after the Chapter 2 main mission Moses, where you take a vehicle to Moses, who runs Watkins Auto Parts in Port Gellhorn. To register a car, steal one with no tracker — check with a WAiNK scan, which shows the registration cost — drive it to Moses, choose Respray, then Register. The first registration is the story car itself. From Chapter 3, cars with standard trackers can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray instead. Each registration needs a free garage space, so buy garages first, and use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep the fees low. Do not steal the car right outside Moses' shop — he refuses cars stolen on his doorstep.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses to install Scooter Bros.
Scan cars with WAiNK and steal tracker-free ones.
Drive each to Moses, choose Respray, then Register — ten times.
